```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(qualtRics)

url <- "https://ca1.qualtrics.com"
api_key <- "3f2XnLK61vaO3nnMcpw4ulWNF8rdlYU8eAHAlAG0"

qualtrics_api_credentials(api_key = api_key, 
                          base_url = url,
                          install = TRUE,
                          overwrite=T)

surveys <- all_surveys() 
pc_id <- surveys[surveys['name']=='Political Candidates',][['id']]

pc_survey <- fetch_survey(surveyID = pc_id, 
                         verbose = TRUE)
```
```{r}
pc_survey %>% 
  distinct(Status)

# validate survey logic
pc_survey %>% 
  filter(Status == 'Survey Test')

pc_survey %>% 
  filter(Status == 'Survey Test', Consent == 'I do not consent to participate') %>% 
  distinct(`Q2`)

pc_survey %>% 
  filter(Status == 'Survey Test', PreScreen_Q1 != 'Yes',
         StartDate >= lubridate::ymd("2023-11-06")) %>% 
  distinct(Q1)
```
```{r}
pc_survey_test <- pc_survey %>% 
  filter(Status == 'Survey Test') %>% 
  mutate(profile = case_when(rnum <= pi1 ~ 1,
                            rnum > pi1 & rnum <= pi2 ~ 2,
                            rnum > pi2 & rnum <= pi3 ~ 3,
                            rnum > pi3 & rnum <= pi4 ~ 4,
                            rnum > pi4 & rnum <= pi5 ~ 5,
                            rnum > pi5 & rnum <= pi6 ~ 6,
                            rnum > pi6 & rnum <= pi7 ~ 7,
                            rnum > pi7 ~ 8))


# check in large sample
pc_survey_test %>% 
  ggplot(aes(profile)) +
  geom_histogram()
```
```{r}
pc_survey_recode <- pc_survey_test %>% 
  mutate(across(str_c("Q", 1:8), ~case_when(. == "Candidate 1" & rnum_age <= 0.5 ~ 1,
                                            . == "Candidate 2" & rnum_age > 0.5 ~ 1,
                                            TRUE ~ 0))) %>% 
  mutate(total_Q = select(., str_c("Q", 1:8)) %>%
           rowSums())

pc_survey_recode %>% 
  select(str_c("Q", 1:8)) %>% 
  rowSums()
```
```{r}
# create fake data
pc_survey_fake <- data.frame(matrix(0, ncol = 8, nrow = 1000))
names(pc_survey_fake) <- str_c("Q", 1:8)
pc_survey_fake['profile'] <- 0

for (i in 1:1000) {
  rnum <- runif(1)
  profile <- case_when(rnum < 0.22 ~ 1,
                       rnum >= 0.22 & rnum < 0.25 ~ 2,
                       rnum >= 0.25 & rnum < 0.375 ~ 3,
                       rnum >= 0.375 & rnum < 0.5 ~ 4,
                       rnum >= 0.5 & rnum < 0.625 ~ 5,
                       rnum >= 0.625 & rnum < 0.75 ~ 6,
                       rnum >= 0.75 & rnum < 0.875 ~ 7,
                       rnum >= 0.875 ~ 8)
  if (profile == 1) {
    pc_survey_fake[i,str_c("Q", profile)] <- 1
  } else {
    pc_survey_fake[i,str_c("Q", profile)] <- if_else(runif(1) <= 0.2, 1, 0)
  }
  pc_survey_fake[i, 'profile'] <- profile
}

pc_survey_fake %>% 
  ggplot(aes(profile)) +
  geom_histogram()

pc_survey_fake %>% 
  filter(profile == 2) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(Q2))

pc_survey_fake %>% 
  filter(profile == 1) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(Q1))
```
```{r}
c <- 8
profiles_selected <- integer(0)
numbers_of_rewards_1 <- integer(c) # vector for each arm
numbers_of_rewards_0 <- integer(c)
total_reward <- 0
max_random <- 0
profile <- 1

for (n in 1:nrow(pc_survey_fake)) { # for N runs
  i <- pc_survey_fake[n, 'profile']
  
  # draw from prior distribution for theta
  # for each arm
  random_theta <- rbeta(
    n = 1,
    shape1 = numbers_of_rewards_1[i] + 1,
    shape2 = numbers_of_rewards_0[i] + 1
  )
  
  # print(str_glue("{random_theta}"))
  # print(str_glue("{i}"))
  if (random_theta > max_random) {
      # print(str_glue("better than previous for {n}, profile {i}"))
      # if arm is better than all the previous ones
      # this arm is selected, choose theta
      max_random <- random_theta
      profile <- i
  }
  
  # after selecting the argmax, add to selected profile
  profiles_selected <- append(profiles_selected, profile)
  
  # checking with data (what is *observed*)
  reward <- pc_survey_fake[n, str_c("Q",profile)]
  if (reward == 1) {
    numbers_of_rewards_1[profile] <- numbers_of_rewards_1[profile] + 1
  } else {
    numbers_of_rewards_0[profile] <- numbers_of_rewards_0[profile] + 1
  }
  total_reward <- total_reward + reward
}

numbers_of_rewards_1
numbers_of_rewards_0
```
